Nice analogy! When it comes to driving on snow, one has to consider the type of snow too. Yesterday, here in Denver, I drove to work on three inches of fluffy stuff. It was like I was floating – no road noise at all. This is much different than driving on an inch of ice (which I have also experienced while living in north Texas).
This is also analogous to engineering software. Since there are many types of problems, with many types of platforms, with many types of software development life cycles. And all are evolving! This makes finding experience extremely hard to find!
